name: Mat-Su Salmon Partnership NFHP Funding Call
summary: Annual call for salmon habitat projects in Alaska's Mat-Su Basin, passing proposals to the National Fish Habitat Partnership for funding: riparian and instream restoration, barrier removal, habitat assessment and monitoring.

amount.note: Regional projects; larger projects will be considered

status.quote: Project proposals are due via email by 11:59pm (AKST) on Monday, September 14, 2026.

deadline.quote: Project proposals are due via email by 11:59pm (AKST) on Monday, September 14, 2026.

geography.quote: It was formed to provide a broad-based coordinated response to increasing impacts on salmon habitat from human use and development in the Mat-Su Basin.

access.quote: Applicants need to prepare and submit a project proposal that describes their project and its benefits for fish habitat.

window.quote: is announcing its annual invitation for fish habitat conservation project proposals for Federal Fiscal Year 2027 (FY27)

amount.quote: be available to cover 3-6 regional projects ranging from $10,000 to $75,000, but larger projects will be considered.

co_finance_required.quote: Although match at the individual project level is no longer required

applicant_types.quote: Any individual or organization can apply who has the capacity to receive federal funds and satisfy funding reporting requirements.
